deadline.value: Applicants to the Chemistry PhD must have all documents in by February 15 for full fall consideration.
deadline.quote: All required documents are due to the Office of Graduate Admissions by February 15 for full fall consideration.

also.quote: Applied Biology, Chemistry and Polymer Science Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) Applicants

gre_general.value: The Kennedy College lists GRE only for Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences, so the Chemistry Ph.D. does not require it.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are only required for the following programs: | Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry GRE Subject test is not required for the Chemistry Ph.D.
gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are only required for the following programs: | Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences.

supervisor.value: Research may begin as late as the second semester, so admission does not depend on a named advisor.
supervisor.quote: The dissertation research of each graduate student may be initiated at any time but not later than the end of the second semester in the program.

funding.value: The department says it strives to fund all admitted PhD students through assistantships that depend on availability.
funding.quote: UMass Lowell strives to provide financial support for all admitted Ph.D. students.

also.quote: Assistantships are contingent upon availability and may be subject to change.

entry_route.value: Applicants need an earned bachelor's degree in chemistry or a listed related field.
entry_route.quote: applicant will have an earned bachelor's degree in one of the following fields: chemistry, chemical or civil engineering, biology, environmental sciences, geology or physics

notes: Options: Biochemistry, Environmental Studies and Sustainability. The Ph.D. in Polymer Science is saved as the materials program.
